description: LoanScout is an online loan comparison tool that helps U.S. borrowers explore personal loan, installment loan, emergency loan, cash advance, and bad credit loan options before applying. Users can compare loan amounts, estimated rates and fees, state availability, funding speed, eligibility requirements, and lender details in one place.
